operations.title: Notice Search
operations.description: Search NYC City Record notices (the daily-refreshed mirror). Keyword terms are OR-matched; add structured filters to narrow. Amounts are validity-filtered (data-entry errors excluded); rolling placeholder deadlines are labeled, never shown as dates.

operations.title: Notice Get
operations.description: Get one public City Record notice by its exact RequestID. The result preserves materialized-source freshness and distinguishes a missing public notice from a read that cannot be served.

freshness.owner: materialized notice mirror with public-source fallback

provider.store: Cloudflare D1 with City Record fallback

operations.title: Entity Dossier Get
operations.description: Get the bounded public dossier for one exact canonical CityScroll entity. Preserves attributed disagreements, availability, provenance, and public redaction.

provider.readModel: canonical entities plus accepted source-record links

operations.title: Entity Relationships Get
operations.description: Traverse bounded, evidence-bearing public relationships from one exact canonical CityScroll entity. Only the closed node and edge vocabularies are returned.

input_contract.traversal: incident edges from one root; no graph query language

provenance.confidence: graph.edges[].confidence status and basis; no private score

freshness.owner: D1 entity-resolution read model plus committed public graph overlays

provider.store: Cloudflare D1 plus committed public graph overlay
provider.readModel: canonical entities plus accepted source-record and evaluated public edges

operations.title: Cited Passages Retrieve
operations.description: Retrieve source passages with stable citations and exact source joins. Returns source text only; it does not generate an answer or infer civic relationships.

authority.semantics: retrieval evidence only; no answer or inferred civic relationship

input_contract.query: resident search terms plus closed structured scope

freshness.owner: committed semantic retrieval corpus manifest and source-passage map
freshness.projection: citation freshness plus corpus and passage-map observation clocks

provider.readModel: typed candidates joined exactly to source passages and corpus manifest records

operations.title: Search Federated
operations.description: Search the registered public CityScroll lenses in one bounded result set. Optional scope selects only allowlisted registered lenses. Preserves per-lens coverage, source observations, exact object routes, and federated ranking; it does not expose a raw store or arbitrary query language.

authority.semantics: bounded SearchDocument federation; no raw store or query language

input_contract.query: bounded resident search text; no arbitrary filter or store query

scope.omitted: legacy all-registered-lens federation, including auxiliary legal-code recall
scope.mapping: closed allowlist of registered federation lenses; presentation lanes and store queries are rejected

coverageSemantics.matched: one or more admitted documents were observed
coverageSemantics.empty: the participating indexed lens observed zero matches
coverageSemantics.partial: the lens participated using the available portion of its registered source index
coverageSemantics.stale: the lens result is retained with an out-of-date source clock
coverageSemantics.not_indexed: the lens has no registered served index for this request
coverageSemantics.provider_unavailable: the registered lens provider failed; absence is not an empty result
coverageSemantics.out_of_scope: the lens was not in the requested allowlist and was not queried

freshness.projection: per-lens as_of and coverage state are retained; incomplete coverage is not collapsed

provider.readModel: SearchDocument producers plus universal search federator

operations.title: Contracts Analysis
operations.description: Rank groups by agency, vendor, fiscal year, or amount band. Uses the registered-contract population. Reports registered value or contract count, a scope denominator, coverage, and exact contract IDs. Does not report payments or spending.

input_contract.identity: one row per exact prime_contract_id in the registered-contract projection

filters.agency: case-insensitive exact agency label after projection normalization
filters.vendor: case-insensitive exact prime-vendor label after projection normalization
filters.retroactive: only rows with a published registration/start-date comparison

output.measure: current registered contract value in USD

provenance.drillThrough: ordinary Contracts scope with exact contributing contract identifiers
